title: Path traversal in static file handler allows reading arbitrary files
description: The static file handler in handlers/files.py joins the user-supplied path to the document root without normalizing or rejecting '..' segments. A request for /static/..%2f..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd resolves outside the document root and returns the file contents. serve_static() passes the decoded path to os.path.join and then open() with no containment check.
